root_cohort.source: corrected C1 V2 primary regular d8 cells

leaf_classifier_order: C0 corrected V3 at micro-depth 2: PROVEN_EMPTY_POSITIVE or PROVEN_EMPTY_NEGATIVE => terminal EMPTY
otherwise C2 V2 axis-graph: PROVEN_AXIS_GRAPH_PATCH => terminal GRAPH
otherwise, if relative refinement depth remains => split into 8 octants

refinement_ladder.split_rule: uniform octants only for unresolved leaves

proof_semantics.EMPTY: whole leaf box has one strict field sign under corrected C0 research arithmetic
proof_semantics.GRAPH: leaf zero set is a certified single-valued local coordinate-axis graph patch
proof_semantics.UNRESOLVED: neither absence nor local graph simplicity was certified; must refine or abstain

primary_metrics: terminal EMPTY / GRAPH / UNRESOLVED leaf counts at each ladder level
unresolved root-volume fraction at each ladder level
number of root boxes whose full descendant partition is closed by EMPTY-or-GRAPH leaves
graph patch count and selected-axis distribution
C0 PROVEN_ZERO_EXISTS leaves that remain unresolved

existence_root_audit.rule: If an existence-proven root becomes fully closed, at least one descendant must be GRAPH. An all-EMPTY closed partition is a soundness alarm.
